response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM t), e AS (SELECT t.circuitId, t.race_count, t.share, t.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM t, a WHERE t.share > a.avg_share), r AS (SELECT e.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM e) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC
